name: smwsprites-needle-spitting-urchin
title: Needle-spitting Urchin
description:
This Urchin is static, but spits needles at the player. The first extra byte controls the timer, the second controls the pattern type, and the third controls the direction. Patterns include horizontal only, vertical only, both, or a tracking needle.

The needle has a poison feature, which requires UberASMTool.
